test_cases.name: Current News Retrieval
test_cases.input: What are the top headlines in world news today?
success_criteria: Returns a list of current top world news headlines
Information is from reputable news sources
Headlines are no more than 24 hours old

test_cases.name: Weather Information
test_cases.input: What's the weather forecast for New York City for the next 3 days?
success_criteria: Provides weather forecast for New York City
Covers the next 3 days
Includes temperature and general weather conditions

test_cases.name: Stock Market Data
test_cases.input: What's the current stock price of Apple Inc.?
success_criteria: Returns the current stock price of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
Price is no more than 20 minutes old
Includes the stock exchange where the price was quoted

test_cases.name: Sports Results
test_cases.input: Who won the last NBA championship?
success_criteria: Correctly identifies the most recent NBA champion
Provides the year of the championship
Includes the team they defeated in the finals

test_cases.name: Movie Information
test_cases.input: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies of all time?
success_criteria: Lists the top 5 highest-grossing movies
Includes the gross revenue for each movie
Information is up-to-date

test_cases.name: Euro 2024 Match Schedule
test_cases.input: When did Spain play against Germany in the Euros 2024?
success_criteria: Correctly identifies the date as 05.07.2024
Confirms that this is a match between Spain and Germany in Euro 2024
Potentially provides additional context about the tournament or match

test_cases.name: Currency Exchange Rate
test_cases.input: What's the current exchange rate between USD and EUR?
success_criteria: Provides the current USD to EUR exchange rate
Rate is no more than 1 hour old
Specifies the source of the exchange rate information

test_cases.name: Celebrity Information
test_cases.input: How old is Tom Hanks and what was his latest movie?
success_criteria: Correctly states Tom Hanks' current age
Identifies his most recent movie release
Information is accurate and up-to-date

test_cases.name: Recent Historical Event
test_cases.input: What was the outcome of the most recent presidential election in France?
success_criteria: Provides the name of the winner of the most recent French presidential election
Includes the year of the election
May provide brief additional context such as the margin of victory

test_cases.name: Product Price Comparison
test_cases.input: What's the price range for the latest iPhone model across major retailers?
success_criteria: Provides price range for the latest iPhone model
Includes prices from at least 3 major retailers
Information is current (no more than 24 hours old)

test_cases.name: Current Scientific Research
test_cases.input: What are the latest findings in research on giant sequoia trees' resilience to climate change?
success_criteria: Provides information on recent (within the last 2 years) research findings
Information is from a reputable scientific source
Includes the implications of these findings for conservation efforts

test_cases.name: Technology News
test_cases.input: What are the latest developments in artificial intelligence?
success_criteria: Provides recent news or breakthroughs in AI
Information is from the last 30 days
Includes sources from reputable tech news outlets

test_cases.name: Recent Literary Award
test_cases.input: Who won the most recent Booker Prize and for which book?
success_criteria: Correctly identifies the most recent Booker Prize winner
Provides the title of the winning book
Includes the year of the award

test_cases.name: Travel Information
test_cases.input: What are the entry requirements for U.S. citizens traveling to Japan?
success_criteria: Lists current entry requirements for U.S. citizens to Japan
Includes visa information if applicable
Mentions any COVID-19 related restrictions or requirements

test_cases.name: Music Chart Information
test_cases.input: What's the current number one song on the Billboard Hot 100?
success_criteria: Identifies the current #1 song on the Billboard Hot 100
Includes the artist name
Information is from the most recent chart update

test_cases.name: Current Health Guidelines
test_cases.input: What are the current recommended daily intake levels for vitamin D according to the WHO?
success_criteria: Provides the most up-to-date WHO recommendations for daily vitamin D intake
Specifies different recommendations for different age groups if applicable
Includes the date or year of the most recent guidelines

test_cases.name: Educational Institution Ranking
test_cases.input: What are the top 5 universities in the world according to the latest rankings?
success_criteria: Lists the top 5 universities from a recognized global ranking
Specifies the ranking system used (e.g., QS World University Rankings)
Information is from the most recent ranking release

test_cases.name: Legal Information
test_cases.input: What is the current federal minimum wage in the United States?
success_criteria: Provides the current federal minimum wage in the U.S.
Information is up-to-date and accurate
May mention any pending changes or state variations

test_cases.name: Environmental Data
test_cases.input: What is the current air quality index in Beijing?
success_criteria: Provides the current Air Quality Index (AQI) for Beijing
Information is no more than 3 hours old
Includes the source of the air quality data

test_cases.name: Software Version Information
test_cases.input: What is the latest stable version of Python and when was it released?
success_criteria: Identifies the latest stable version of Python
Provides the release date of this version
Information is accurate and up-to-date

evaluation_metrics.accuracy: Percentage of test cases where the retrieved information is correct and meets all success criteria
evaluation_metrics.relevance: Degree to which the retrieved information directly answers the query
evaluation_metrics.timeliness: Assessment of how current the retrieved information is
evaluation_metrics.source_quality: Evaluation of the credibility and reliability of the information sources used
evaluation_metrics.agent_selection: Percentage of test cases where the WebRetriever agent was correctly selected
